title: InventoryItem
description: Warehouse inventory record synchronized nightly between the ERP and the storefront. No dialect declaration on purpose: consumers validate with their bundled default draft.

sku.description: Unique stock keeping unit; uppercase letters, digits, and hyphens only, between 4 and 32 characters. SKUs are never reused, even after an item is discontinued.

warehouseId.description: Identifier of the warehouse holding this stock line. One SKU may appear once per warehouse.

availableQuantity.description: Units currently sellable from this warehouse; reserved units are excluded from availableQuantity until the reservation is released or fulfilled, so the storefront can promise only what is genuinely free.

reservedQuantity.description: Units held against open orders. Reservations expire with their order and flow back into availableQuantity automatically.

reorderPoint.description: Replenishment trigger. When availableQuantity falls at or below reorderPoint, the item is flagged for replenishment in the nightly procurement job and a purchase suggestion is created.

reorderQuantity.description: Suggested order size used when the replenishment flag is raised; buyers may override it per purchase order.

unitCostCents.description: Latest landed cost per unit in minor currency units, used for margin reporting only, never shown to shoppers.

lotTracked.description: True when this SKU requires lot numbers on receipt and shipment, which is mandatory for perishable goods.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last synchronization from the ERP, RFC 3339 formatted.
